newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Int'l Bnk of Asia to launch HK$1 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Bnk of Asia to launch HK$1 bln FRCD.

text.p: International Bank of Asia will launch a HK$1.0 billion multi-tranche floating rate certificates of deposit issue shortly, bankers said.
The certificates have a three-year tenor and will be available in either Hong Kong or U.S. dollars.

With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is expected to be 72 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate for the Hong Kong dollar tranche and 57 basis points over LIBOR for the U.S. dollar tranche.
Fuji International Finance (HK), Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong, Westpac Banking Corp, Standard Chartered Bank, WestLB and Sakura Finance Asia are arrangers.
The issue is off the bank's HK$2.0 billion CD issuance programme.
International Bank of Asia has received BBB long-term rating from Standard and Poor's Corp.
